title: Claim-Scoped Diagnostic Gates for Interpretable Machine Learning
text: mlr3autoiml implements Claim-Scoped Diagnostic Gates (CSDG) mlr3 ecosystem. CSDG replaces question “explanation show?” “evidence support claim?” workflow five steps: write claim, conclusion intend report (csdg_claim()); specify scope six elements, quantity, model, procedure, data, meaning, use; derive properties claim requires 12 gates (csdg_gate_registry(), csdg_gate_plan()); evaluate evidence required property (csdg_evidence_record(), diagnostics csdg_audit()); decide report fixed rule (csdg_adjudicate_claim()). package records claim scope, derives gate plan, computes diagnostics, applies decision rule. researcher sets criteria, states relevance observation, enters established counterevidence unresolved threats. Favorable results never offset contradicted property, aggregate score computed. title: Gate Base Class — Gate
text: Abstract base class diagnostic gates AutoIML workflow. Gates operate context environment includes: task: mlr3::Task learner: mlr3::Learner (cloned safety) resampling: mlr3::Resampling rr: mlr3::ResampleResult (already computed) final_model: trained learner (optional) pred: merged mlr3::Prediction object (optional) purpose: scalar purpose string quick_start: logical flag seed: integer seed (optional) Concrete gate implementations inherit class override run() method.

title: Gate 0A: Scope Claim & Use (Claim-First) — Gate0AClaim
text: Establishes validates intended interpretive claim(s) (global / local / decision) semantics explanations interpreted. gate makes "meaning" explanation artifacts explicit producing . framework distinguishes three semantics families:

title: Gate 0A: Scope Claim & Use (Claim-First) — Gate0AClaim
text: Within-support associational (-manifold / descriptive) Summarize patterns along empirical joint distribution (interpret interventions). Marginal model query (model-based, non-causal) "model predict set X_j = x?", may break empirical dependence requires explicit support / -manifold diagnostics. Causal / recourse (intervention / action) Requires explicit causal assumptions action-set (mutable features, constraints, costs). package implement causal identification; requesting causal/recourse semantics triggers hard stop. Users can provide claim specification via ctx$claim (config = list(claim = ...)). Conservative defaults filled based purpose.

title: Gate 0B: Measurement / Construct Readiness — Gate0BMeasurement
text: Screens whether measurement/construct considerations sufficiently addressed modeling explanation. gate deliberately conservative: many psychometric properties (reliability, invariance/comparability) inferred modeling dataset alone. Instead, users can provide minimal measurement specification via ctx$measurement (config = list(measurement = list(...))). high-stakes decision/deployment settings, missing critical measurement evidence (measurement level, reliability, subgroup comparability subgroup analyses scope) treated failure.

title: Gate 0B: Measurement / Construct Readiness — Gate0BMeasurement
text: Summarize missingness rates (feature-level) flag high missingness Detect whether task provides subgroup variables (via ctx$sensitive_features)

title: Gate 0B: Measurement / Construct Readiness — Gate0BMeasurement
text: Reliability evidence (e.g., omega/alpha scale scores, test-retest) Invariance/comparability evidence across relevant groups Whether predictors composites/scale scores vs. single items vs. latent scores

what: mlr3autoiml: Claim-Scoped Diagnostic Gates for Interpretable Machine Learning — mlr3autoiml-package
title: mlr3autoiml: Claim-Scoped Diagnostic Gates for Interpretable Machine Learning — mlr3autoiml-package
text: mlr3autoiml implements Claim-Scoped Diagnostic Gates (CSDG) mlr3 tasks learners. CSDG decides whether evidence supports conclusion drawn explanation machine learning model. workflow five steps. Step 1 writes claim, conclusion researcher intends report (csdg_claim()). Step 2 specifies scope six elements: quantity, model, procedure, data, meaning, use. Step 3 derives required properties 12 gates (csdg_gate_registry(), csdg_gate_plan()). Step 4 evaluates evidence: required property supported, contradicted, open, established counterevidence, unresolved threats, context recorded separately (csdg_evidence_record(); diagnostics csdg_audit()). Step 5 applies fixed decision rule (csdg_adjudicate_claim()): claim met required property contradicted; otherwise unresolved one open; otherwise met. met claim retained; otherwise claim revised withheld (csdg_claim_revision(), csdg_claim_relation()). Favorable results never offset contradicted property, aggregate score computed. package records claim scope, derives gate plan, computes diagnostics, applies rule; researcher sets criteria, states relevance observation, enters established counterevidence unresolved threats. package also retains earlier AutoIML workflow compatibility earlier analyses. gate identifiers (G0A G7B, combined G3 G6) pass/warn/fail/skip labels legacy heuristic diagnostics; CSDG gate registry vocabulary. Reusable package components implement claim records, gate plans, resampling diagnostics, held-permutation feature importance corrected resampled intervals, calibration, ALE bootstrap, local-fidelity audits, importance agreement, matched-setting utilities, reporting, provenance. Study-specific sampling, outcome loops, exclusion schedules, manuscript synthesis remain analysis scripts.
